note: Deterministic transaction/authorization coverage. LIVE browser transaction results are not claimed: no chat command reached the resolver (see REPORT.md).
covered: adapter resolution is stable and refuses ambiguity instead of guessing
a registered world destination missing from the live scene is reported stale, not dropped
discovery is read-only: no revision, no object and no foreign registry changes
an unapproved composition commit is refused and changes nothing
an approved composition commits every object and link as exactly one revision
a plan built against an older revision is refused instead of overwriting the newer scene
a renderer that disagrees with the commit causes a rollback, not a claim of success
camera focus refuses an unknown target with candidates instead of moving somewhere
camera verification fails honestly when the camera never arrived
renderer verification reports a missing mesh as a failure, and an unattached renderer as skipped
chat maps camera, composition and approval phrases to real intents
end to end from chat: plan, approve, commit as one revision
Tier 4 runs only under a single-use owner approval, never by self-elevation
moving a Cosmos entity through chat is refused with its owner and changes nothing
